description: Prepare an iOS Simulator: boot, install a simulator .app (consent-gated), launch, verify, and report whether WDA structured automation or visual-only mode is available. .ipa files are refused.

allowLaunchWithoutMetro.description: Launch a debug RN/Expo .app (no embedded main.jsbundle) without a serving Metro (it will RedBox).

attachWda.description: auto (default): attach WDA if reachable, else visual-only; required: fail if it cannot attach; skip: visual-only.

device.description: Simulator UDID or exact name (ignoring case).
